title: SettlementTerm
description: Describes the terms of settlement associated with a given transaction. v2.1 adds V1 ONDC TRV10 settlement and payment fields from BUYER_FINDER_FEES, SETTLEMENT_TERMS, and SETTLEMENT_DETAILS tag groups, plus CASH as an accepted payment method.

amount.description: Amount associated with this settlement action

paymentTrigger.description: Describes the event which triggers the payment against this settlement term

payTo.description: Details of the account where the money must be remitted

acceptedPaymentMethods.description: Payment methods accepted for this settlement. v2.1 adds CASH.

settlementTermAttributes.description: Additional use case specific settlement terms

collectedBy.description: Party responsible for collecting the payment (BAP or BPP). Maps to V1 payment.collected_by.

paymentStatus.description: Current payment status. Maps to V1 payment.status (e.g. NOT-PAID, PAID).

paymentType.description: When the payment is collected relative to service fulfillment. Maps to V1 payment.type.

paymentInstrument.description: The specific payment instrument used (e.g. Cash, UPI, CARD). Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_TERMS.PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT.

settlementAmount.description: The actual settlement amount for this transaction. Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_TERMS.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT.

settlementWindow.description: ISO 8601 duration within which settlement must be completed. Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_TERMS.SETTLEMENT_WINDOW.

delayInterest.description: Interest rate (%) charged per day for delayed settlement. Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_TERMS.DELAY_INTEREST.

settlementBasis.description: Basis on which settlement is calculated. Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_TERMS.SETTLEMENT_BASIS.

mandatoryArbitration.description: Whether arbitration is mandatory for dispute resolution. Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_TERMS.MANDATORY_ARBITRATION.

courtJurisdiction.description: City or jurisdiction of the court governing dispute resolution. Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_TERMS.COURT_JURISDICTION.

staticTerms.description: URL pointing to the static legal terms and conditions document. Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_TERMS.STATIC_TERMS.

buyerFinderFeesPercentage.description: Percentage fee charged by the BAP for finding the buyer. Maps to V1 BUYER_FINDER_FEES.BUYER_FINDER_FEES_PERCENTAGE.

commission.description: Commission amount deducted by the network or BAP. Maps to V1 SETTLEMENT_DETAILS.COMMISSION.

tags.description: V1-compatible tag groups preserved verbatim for lossless V2→V1 round-trip.
